# Penguin Academy - Web Content Summary

**Overview:**
Penguin Academy is Singapore's official SSI (Scuba Schools International) certification centre, offering globally recognised aquatic education programs for aspiring and practicing swim teachers. The academy trains candidates to become certified swim instructors through structured, premium coaching pathways.

**Contact Information:**
- Email: swim@penguinswimschool.sg
- WhatsApp: +65 8955 3399
- SSI Instructor Profile: https://my.divessi.com/pro/121320

**Core Course Offerings (all prices SGD):**
- Penguin Pro Bundle – SSI Level 1 + Level 2 with React Right: $2,888 (original bundle value $3,376)
- SSI Swim Teacher Level 1 (includes React Right): $1,688 – 1 full day
- SSI Swim Teacher Level 2 (includes React Right): $1,688 – 1 full day
- SSI Baby & Me (includes React Right): $1,688 – 1 full day
- SSI Adult (includes React Right): $1,688 – 1 full day
- React Right only: $100 – 1 full day

**Course Format:**
- Schedule: courses can run every day
- Daily hours: 9am to 6pm
- Class size: minimum 1, maximum 8
- Venue: CBD / Central Singapore
- Format: in-person for Singapore students; overseas format can be discussed separately
- Assessment: theory and practical assessment
- Attachment: at least 8 in-water attachment sessions with Penguin Swim Classes required to pass any course

**Who This Is For:**
Aspiring swim teachers, current swim coaches seeking official SSI certification, fitness/aquatics professionals expanding into swim instruction, and candidates seeking a structured pathway from certification through mentorship in Singapore.

**Geographic Coverage:**
Singapore-based certification centre with in-person training in CBD / Central Singapore.

**Key Differentiators:**
Official SSI-affiliated certification centre, globally recognised credentials, structured multi-level course pathway, lifetime mentorship, lifetime refresher at a discounted rate (payable by coach), lifetime Penguin Family membership, 24/7 Penguin Support, premium small-group instruction.

**Testimonials:**
Reviews may be referenced from the Penguin Swim School Google Business Profile.

**Related Organisation:**
Penguin Academy is affiliated with Penguin Swim School (https://www.penguinswimschool.sg), a Singapore swim school offering lessons for infants through seniors, sharing the same coaching standards and contact channel.
